one_line: A hostile space alligator basic mob that bites, knocks people down, and grabs downed victims to death-roll and rip off their legs.
player_facing_mechanics: Sentient/controlled alligator can vent-crawl anywhere at will (TRAIT_VENTCRAWLER_ALWAYS), and is told via chat it can open/close its mouth with combat mode
Bites with a 1.5s melee cooldown dealing 5-10 damage with a bite sound and bite visual effect
First hits apply stamina damage (5, then 3) to a standing human; once stamina loss exceeds ~8 the victim is knocked down (SHOVE_KNOCKDOWN_SOLID)
Against a lying-down human with legs and gravity, performs a death roll: buckles the victim, spins both sprites, then severs one leg (removing shoes first) after the animation
Death roll has a cooldown (animation length + 1.5s) and refuses without gravity, if on cooldown, if target is elevated and alligator is not, or if the target has no legs
Ripped-off leg disappears into the alligator and has an 80% chance to be recoverable/thrown out if the alligator is gibbed
Butchering yields one gator cloak and two meat slabs
Alligator is a hostile spawn from gold cores
1% of alligators spawn as a 'floppy disk' variant whose diet includes the nuclear authentication disk (and its description gains a floppy-disk line)
Non-sentient alligator visibly opens its mouth (icon_state croc_open) when it has an AI target or is moving; controlled one opens mouth when in combat mode

traits (ADD_TRAIT, add_traits/remove_traits, TRAIT_VENTCRAWLER_ALWAYS, TRAIT_CANNOT_BE_UNBUCKLED, TRAIT_INCAPACITATED, TRAIT_IMMOBILIZED, TRAIT_FLOORED, TRAIT_HANDS_BLOCKED, TRAIT_GODMODE, TRAIT_ELEVATED_TURF)

UnarmedAttack: stamina-damage escalation and knockdown before eating/melee
on_mob_ate / on_gibbed / on_moved / on_dir_change / on_lying_angle_change signal handlers

dir manipulation for facing during the roll
world.time based timing for hunt cooldown
port_notes: Most stat/visual/loot fields map cleanly to an SS14 entity prototype plus a MobThresholds/MeleeWeapon/Butchering components block, but the interactive death-roll needs real code: a dedicated component (storing eating/victim/roll-cooldown state) and a system that handles the combat-mode action, stamina/knockdown gating, DoAfter/parallel animation, and limb dismemberment via BodyPart events. SimpleMob AI maps from ai_controller/planning_subtrees/targeting_strategy to HTN or NPC-faction/world-targeting systems with a custom target filter. BYOND sprites (matrix turn animation, pixel offsets, icon_state mouth states) become SS14 sprite-layer + Appearance/animation work. Design questions a human must answer: how to represent the victim-attached roll state in ECS (component on alligator vs the human), whether to keep the sprite-rotation/pixel fidelity, and how the 1% nuclear-disk diet variant should be authored (random prototype spawn vs component).
